summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K on July 21, 2026, containing a press release with June 2026 production and operations update. The filing details monthly operational metrics for Bitcoin mining (990 BTC mined, up 388% year-over-year), self-mining hash rate of 73.0 EH/s, and AI Cloud ARR of ~$76 million. It also mentions a newly signed 10-year lease for a data center in Malaysia and the executed lease for the Tydal, Norway site. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is announced; the filing is a routine operational update. There are no deal terms, advisor names, or board recommendations.
